This '''Infiltrator''' was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] force that was assigned to [[Unidentified battle (Imperial strongpoint)|take]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] strongpoint. The night before a big push, this [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]] and several others went behind enemy lines to stir up confusion. On the way to the objective, the Infiltrator stopped and checked to see if [[Jop]] was an Alliance trooper or Imperial forward scout by checking his beard growth.
